recommendations.detail: Evidence generator must track and emit the FINAL candidate HEAD (the commit that was actually merged), not an intermediate or stale ref.
Every candidate_commit field must be verified as a real git commit object via git cat-file -t before finalization.
All commit hash fields must contain the full 40-hex hash of a real git object.
The files_modified list in evidence must include every file that was changed.
Candidate creation tasks must never use git amend unless the user explicitly authorizes it.
Merge and push each require their own separate user signoff per governance chain.
If any validator fails (including check_commit_message), the candidate must NOT be marked as candidate_ready. v1 was blocked for this reason.
check_commit_message.py requires that non-merge commits include the manifest round_id in the commit message. Fix branch commits must include this token.
